faq.q: What is a titanium sulfuric acid injection quill?

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium sulfuric acid injection quill?
faq.a: Titanium Sulfuric Acid Injection Quill is designed for dosing injection quill for sulfuric acid (grade 7). The Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium sulfuric acid injection quill manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Sulfuric Acid Injection Quill is manufactured using Seamless tube extrusion. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium sulfuric acid injection quill?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
